steps.body: The number line keeps counting by tens all the way to 100. Every giant hop adds ten.
steps.narration: The tens keep going: 60, 70, 80, 90, 100. Ten jumps reach one hundred.

widget.prompt: Count by tens: start at 70 and make 2 tens-hops. Tap where you land.

commonLandings.feedback: That's 3 hops. Make just 2 from 70 to land on 90.

widget.missFeedback: Start at 70 and make two ten-hops: you land on 90.

predict.prompt: One tens-hop from 70 — how far will you land?
predict.reveal: A tens-hop is one BIG jump of ten: 70 lands on 80, skipping all nine numbers between.

cml.actionGoal: Manipulate the model and track how it represents kcc tens to 100.
invariants: The manipulated model and the mathematical relationship for kcc tens to 100 must stay consistent.
misconceptions: Changing a visible feature without preserving the relationship that defines kcc tens to 100.
cml.counterfactualPrompt: What change would make the model stop representing the same mathematical relationship?

widget.prompt: Count by tens: what comes after 60? Hop one ten and tap where you land.

commonLandings.feedback: That adds just one. Counting by TENS adds a whole ten: 70.
That goes back a ten. Counting forward gives 70.

widget.missFeedback: Start at 60 and make one ten-hop: you land on 70.
widget.successFeedback: One big tens-hop from 60 lands on 70.
